title: A synthetic LCP navigation before and after changes
method: Synthetic LCP stages: initial TTFB 600 + discovery 800 + load 1200 + render 800 =3400 ms. Proposed600 +200 +900 +700 =2400 ms. A single modeled navigation; not a population percentile or measured result.
